datasets.name: Sentinel-2A imagery
datasets.verbatim: Sentinel-2A satellite carries a multispectral imager... Sentinel-2A data are Level-1C (L1C) level data for atmospheric correction. In this article, Sen2cor, a plug-in is used for atmospheric correction of L1C data.

datasets.name: ALOS digital elevation model (DEM) data
datasets.verbatim: Advanced Land Observing Satellite (ALOS) digital elevation model (DEM) data are the elevation data collected by ALOS satellite.

datasets.name: Landslide Database
datasets.verbatim: Based on the historical landslide data and field investigation verification, we obtain landslide boundaries by visual interpretation using high-resolution images from the Google Earth platform. After multiple checks and revisions, 732 landslides are obtained.

methods.name: Heterogeneous ensemble learning landslide recognition model
methods.summary: A stacking-based ensemble learning framework that uses FCN, U-Net, and attention U-Net as base classifiers, with a CNN model acting as a metaclassifier to integrate the base models' predictions for pixel-level landslide segmentation.
methods.verbatim: We develop a heterogeneous ensemble learning landslide recognition model based on FCN, U-Net, and attention U-Net base classifiers, and comprehensively utilize multidimensional features of remote sensing images... In this article, based on the traditional stacking ensemble learning framework, we construct a new heterogeneous ensemble learning framework for landslide identification.

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory is not referenced or linked, and the custom code for the heterogeneous ensemble learning model is not provided.
